speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-acquired pneumonia (likely bacterial superinfection following influenza).

Based on your symptoms of purulent sputum and the recent lack of adherence to flu treatment, I need to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Blood Culture, and Chest_X-Ray.
